pundits.name: Joseph Wang
pundits.bio: Former senior trader at the NY Fed's Open Market Desk. Author of 'Central Banking 101'. Expert on Fed operations, Treasury markets, and liquidity plumbing.
pundits.known_for: Deep expertise in Fed balance sheet mechanics, repo markets, Treasury issuance, and reserve dynamics. Breaks down FOMC decisions and Treasury refunding announcements.

pundits.name: Alfonso Peccatiello
pundits.bio: Former head of fixed income at ING. Runs The Macro Compass, covering global macro, bonds, and cross-asset positioning.
pundits.known_for: Credit impulse analysis, bond market positioning, and macro regime frameworks. Focuses on what moves institutional flows.

pundits.name: Andy Constan
pundits.bio: Former CIO at Bridgewater. Deep expertise in macro trading, volatility, and portfolio construction.
pundits.known_for: Options/vol strategy, macro frameworks, and institutional positioning insights.

pundits.name: Michael Howell
pundits.bio: Founder of CrossBorder Capital. Expert on global liquidity cycles and their impact on asset prices.
pundits.known_for: Global liquidity tracking, Central Bank balance sheet analysis, and liquidity-driven asset allocation.

pundits.name: George Goncalves
pundits.bio: Head of US Macro Strategy at MUFG. Deep rates market expertise.
pundits.known_for: Treasury market analysis, curve trades, and Fed policy implications for rates.

pundits.name: Dario Perkins

pundits.known_for: Witty macro commentary, central bank analysis, and economic cycle frameworks.

pundits.name: Jim Bianco

overton_seeds._comment: Seed terms for the Overton radar from niche/plumbing sources (NOT the VC/agent swarm)

fed_plumbing.description: Fed operating framework where bank reserves are constrained, affecting overnight rates and requiring active Fed intervention.
Hedge fund arbitrage between Treasury cash and futures, creating leveraged exposure that can amplify market stress.
Expiration of the Bank Term Funding Program creating potential liquidity stress for regional banks holding underwater securities.
Debate over when the Fed will stop balance sheet runoff based on reserve levels and money market stress signals.

curve_positioning.description: Yield curve steepening driven by long-end selling, often signaling fiscal concerns or reduced foreign demand.
Return of positive term premium after years of suppression, repricing duration risk in long bonds.
Tension between central bank attempts to manage yield curves and market forces demanding higher term premia.

biotech_genomics.description: Technology mapping gene expression to tissue location, enabling new drug targets and diagnostic approaches.
Machine learning models (like AlphaFold successors) designing novel therapeutic proteins from scratch.
Next-gen CRISPR variants with different precision/safety profiles, competing for therapeutic applications.
Expanding applications of GLP-1 agonists (Ozempic class) to cardiovascular, liver, and addiction indications.
Targeted radiation therapies (like Novartis Pluvicto) as emerging cancer treatment modality with M&A activity.
